set.body:
Goal
Convert Transport energies into honest held-out item probabilities while preventing short or uninformative paths from producing overconfident evidence.

Implementation
Use exhaustive permitted within-participant candidates when feasible, otherwise a frozen set of averaged deterministic panels proven equivalent. Estimate temperature, coverage prior or penalty, warp hyperparameters, and reliability shrinkage only on inner out-of-fold predictions. Shrink low-information posteriors toward the candidate prior using response-blind path support such as effective fixation count.

Acceptance criteria
- gaze_info_bits = log2(p_true/prior_true) is computed from normalized candidate probabilities with the actual candidate prior.
- Fold receipts prove held-out participant-item cells never contribute to nuisance or calibration fitting.
- All four study episodes and all candidates receive identical warp and solver policy.
- Reliability tuning cannot perform worse on inner out-of-fold log loss than the temperature-only boundary solution.
- Fixation count, duration concentration, entropy, and generic gaze quality are exported as diagnostics, not folded into item-specific evidence unless prospectively selected by inner proper score.
- Central/generic gaze quality remains a separate channel and is never relabelled episodic reinstatement.
- Calibration is checked with held-out log loss, reliability curves, candidate-pool-size sensitivity, and prior recovery under null data.
set.title: GW-18.7 Nest calibration, exhaustive candidates, and response-blind reliability
